canonical_target.statement:
namespace ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch

open Filter
/-- Lemma 2.3: the field, alphabet size and invariant group may vary with j. -/
theorem erasure_ambiguity
    (F : ℕ → Type) [∀ j, Field (F j)] [∀ j, Fintype (F j)]
    (M : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ∀ j, Submodule (F j) (Fin (M j) → F j))
    (ρ p : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < 1) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p < 1 - ρ)
    (hsym : ∀ j, DoublyTransitiveCode (M j) (C j))
    (hlength : Tendsto M atTop atTop)
    (hrate : Tendsto (fun j => (Module.finrank (F j) (C j) : ℝ) / M j) atTop (nhds ρ)) :
    Tendsto (fun j => erasureExpectation (C j) p / M j) atTop (nhds 0) := by sorry

end ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch
canonical_target.note: Exact canonical theorem builds and all 11 closed metadata statements check. Recorded axiom audit contains sorryAx through explicitly registered Boolean-analysis leaves. Russo was subsequently promoted with an unchanged signature; the five other analytic leaves remain unresolved. This is a checked reduction, not a completed proof.

children.purpose: Identify the exact M-1-coordinate Boolean event to which sharpness applies.
children.proof_route: Reindex the powerset of univ.erase i by finite subsets of its coordinate subtype. Cardinalities are preserved, so the scalar EXIT curve is exactly a Boolean-event probability on M-1 coordinates.
children.strictly_useful: This finite reindexing prevents accidentally keeping the distinguished coordinate or changing the alphabet assumptions.

children.purpose: Identify the average EXIT curve with any chosen coordinate curve.
children.proof_route: A preserving subgroup also contains inverse permutations. Double transitivity gives ordinary transitivity for M>=2. Coordinate relabeling preserves the Bernoulli law, so all scalar EXIT functions equal their mean. This does not assume capacity.
children.strictly_useful: Only subgroup coordinate relabeling and ordinary transitivity are needed; no Boolean-analysis estimate is used.

children.purpose: Show all actual Boolean pivotal probabilities are equal.
children.proof_route: The stabilizer of i acts transitively on the other coordinates. Transport the event using a code automorphism and reindex the Bernoulli expectation of its discrete gradient. This proves equality of the actual pivotal probabilities, not an unexplained symmetry assertion.
children.strictly_useful: The stabilizer argument discharges the symmetry hypothesis of a field-free theorem and does not assert its analytic conclusion.

children.purpose: Supply the genuinely analytic sharpness estimate for arbitrary upward Boolean events.
children.proof_route: Choose one compact-interval scalar contraction radius; tensorize. Exact Parseval and gradient identities plus the proved weighted cutoff give Var≤r^(-2k)B sqrt(B/m)+B/(k+1) at a mean-value point with total influence≤B=1/(b−a). Equal influences give each≤B/m. Monotonicity bounds the target product by that variance. First take m→∞ for fixed k and then k→∞. All coefficient algebra, mean-value, and limit steps are explicit Lean proofs; only six genuinely lower-level analytic leaves remain open.
